Campaign wrapped (end time passed April 6, 00:00 CT). Here's the recap:

**Bracket Bust Sweepstakes — final numbers (Mar 30 – Apr 5, CT)**

| Line item | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Post A — "prize details" (pphga, paused Mar 31) | $48.12 | 28,718 | 10 |

Notes:
- Setup: one campaign (`lu1g9`), two line items, US-only, AGE_OVER_21 targeting, Sports/Basketball interest, ALL_ON_TWITTER, goal LINK_CLICKS, $550 total budget across both. Both posts were already approved (ACCEPTED).
- Post B clearly outperformed (0.13% CTR, ~$2.19/click vs A's ~$4.81/click), so on Mar 31 I paused A and shifted budget to B. B's daily budget was trimmed to $73 on Apr 2 to keep the flight inside the $550 cap.
- Total billed $532.99 — under budget.

- One thing to flag: Post A, the more literal "prize details" creative, was the weaker performer; the cheekier copy drove essentially all results.
- Approval status of both promoted posts stayed ACCEPTED/ACTIVE throughout; no disapprovals.
